You will work the evening shift. Working hours can vary between 12:00 PM and 11:00 PM (12:00 PM and 9:00 PM, or 2:00 PM and 11:00 PM)

In this role, you are a key link in the logistics process. You will ensure that everything is processed correctly and on time, so the entire team can continue to operate smoothly.
